definitions.full: H8078. shimmamon שִׁמָּמוֺן noun [masculine] appalment, horror (Ba NB 324 336 ; another view Lag BN 202, 203 ); — absolute Ezek 4:16 drink water ׳בְּשׁ , so 12:19 .
